method.samples: Equal-area triangular subdivision: 3 centroid sectors, then two successive midpoint subdivisions to 12 and 48; each stratum sampled at its centroid; deterministic, no random seed
method.tangent: normalize(cross(world winding normal, world Z)); use world Y when abs(normal.z)>=0.9
method.origin: sample + direction * (union scene AABB diagonal + 1 metre)
method.occluders: ALL render primitives in owning variant/LOD, including skinned mechanisms in saved pose, glyph descendants, glass and backing. COL outside LOD excluded. Double-sided geometric intersections; alpha/blend/texture transparency is not evaluated.
method.normals: cross product of fully transformed world triangle edges, normalized
method.area: half norm of world triangle cross product
method.referenceVisibility: Exact first-hit triangle identity and distance within 1e-7 m of source point; ties at 1e-9 m retained as ambiguity counts
method.depth: reference sample distance minus target first-hit distance; signed along incoming direction, not a clearance threshold
method.histograms: Each global triangle resolves to primitive and local triangle via triangleStart/count. Source area weights are area/sample count; they are neither target triangle area nor projected camera coverage.
method.semantics: Whole-render-scene diagnostic denominator. Not semantic plate count, continuous visibility, photometric rendering, or a visual grade.
